jobs.text: The Teesta rises in Sikkim and flows for more than a hundred kilometres through Bangladesh before joining the Jamuna. In the monsoon it floods, and in winter it can shrink to a thread; sharing its water with India has long been discussed between the two countries. The Teesta Barrage, completed in 1990, irrigates a large area.

jobs.text: Work on the Kantajew Temple began in 1704 under Maharaja Pran Nath of Dinajpur and was finished in 1722. Its brick walls are covered in terracotta plaques showing scenes from the Ramayana and Mahabharata, as well as hunters, dancers and ordinary village life. It is widely considered the finest terracotta temple in Bangladesh.
